```{r}
ExWAS_SDOH_Exposures <- SDOH_Data_All %>% 
  mutate(Edu_Any = case_when(!is.na(Max_Edu) ~ Max_Edu,
                             is.na(Max_Edu) ~ Mat_Edu,
                             !is.na(Mat_Edu) ~ Mat_Edu)) %>% 
  mutate(Mat_Child_Comb_Race = case_when(!is.na(Child_Race) ~ Child_Race,
                             is.na(Child_Race) ~ Mat_Race,
                             !is.na(Mat_Race) ~ Mat_Race)) %>% 
  mutate(Mat_Age = as.numeric(Mat_Age)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Location = relevel(as.factor(Location),ref = "United_States")) %>% 
mutate(Location_Country = case_when(Location == "United_States"  ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "NorthEast_US" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "New_Hampshire" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Washington_State" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Midwestern_US" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Denver" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Baltimore" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Sacramento" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Southern_California" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Syracuse" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Michigan" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "California" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "SanFrancisco" ~ "United_States",
                                    Location == "Massachusetts" ~ "United_States",
                                    TRUE ~ "Worldwide")) %>% 
  mutate(Mat_Edu_Binary = case_when(
  Mat_Edu %in% c("No_Education",
                 "Primary_Education",
                 "Primary_School",
                 "High_School") ~ "No_College",
  Mat_Edu %in% c("Some_College",
                 "Four_Year_College_Degree",
                 "Some_Grad_School") ~ "Some_College",
  Mat_Edu == "Not_Reported" ~ NA
)) %>% 
  mutate(Mat_Income_Binary = case_when(
  Mat_Income %in% c("0_25k", "25_49k") ~ "Under_49k",
  Mat_Income %in% c("50_74k", "75_99k", "100_124k", 
                "Over_100k", "Over_125k", "Over_49k") ~ "Over_49k",
  TRUE ~ NA
)) %>% 
    mutate(Study =  str_remove(Study, '[_]\\w+|:')) 


ExWAS_SDOH_Exposures$Mat_Edu <- ExWAS_SDOH_Exposures$Mat_Edu %>%
  fct_recode(
    "Primary"       = "Primary_School",
    "Primary"       = "Primary_Education",
    "High School"   = "High_School",
    "Some College"  = "Some_College",
    "College"       = "Four_Year_College_Degree",
    "Grad School"   = "Some_Grad_School",
    "Other"         = "Other",
    "None"          = "No_Education"
  ) %>%
  fct_relevel("None", "Primary", "High School", "Some College",
              "College", "Grad School", "Other")


Ref_Vars <- c("Mat_Age","Mat_Edu","Mat_Income", "Max_Edu","Child_Age","Mat_Race","Child_Race","Child_Sex")



Child_SDOH <- ExWAS_SDOH_Exposures %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Child_PID) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Study,Child_PID,Mat_PID,all_of(Ref_Vars)) 


Mat_SDOH <- ExWAS_SDOH_Exposures %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Mat_PID) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Study,Child_PID,Mat_PID,all_of(Ref_Vars))
```

```{r}
mypal <- paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_20")

pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Burden_RainCloud.pdf",height = 8, width = 10)
  curr_data_child <- Burden_Df_Child %>% 
    arrange(Study) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID") %>% 
    mutate(plot_value = Total_Val,
           ID = as.numeric(ID)) %>% 
      mutate(Study_num = as.numeric(factor(Study)) * 8,
             Group = "Child")   # *2 doubles the gap
    studies <- levels(factor(curr_data_child$Study))

  p_child <- ggplot(curr_data_child,aes(x = factor(Study), y = Burden_Adj, fill = factor(Study))) + 
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = .5, width = .8, .width = 0, justification = -.3, point_colour = NA) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = .4, outlier.shape = NA,lwd = .1) +
    #ggdist::stat_dots(side = "left", dotsize = .5, justification = 1.1, binwidth = .1) +
    geom_jitter(width = .05, alpha = .3,size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
    ggtitle("Child Aggregate Exposure") +
    labs(x = "Study",
         y = "Score",
         fill = "Study") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    coord_flip()
  #print(p)
  
  curr_data_mat <- Burden_Df_Mat %>% 
    arrange(Study) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID") %>% 
    mutate(plot_value = Total_Val,
           ID = as.numeric(ID)) %>% 
      mutate(Study_num = as.numeric(factor(Study)) * 8) %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Mat")# *2 doubles the gap
    studies <- levels(factor(curr_data_mat$Study))
    
  p_adult <- ggplot(curr_data_mat,aes(x = factor(Study), y = Burden_Adj, fill = factor(Study))) + 
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = .5, width = .8, .width = 0, justification = -.3, point_colour = NA) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = .4, outlier.shape = NA,lwd = .1) +
    #ggdist::stat_dots(side = "left", dotsize = .5, justification = 1.1, binwidth = .1) +
    geom_jitter(width = .05, alpha = .3,size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
    ggtitle("Adult Women Aggregate Exposure ") +
        labs(x = "Study",
         y = "Score",
         fill = "Study") +
    theme_classic() +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom") +

    coord_flip()
  #print(p)
  
  All_Data <- bind_rows(curr_data_child,curr_data_mat)

    p <- ggplot(All_Data,aes(x = factor(Study), y = Burden_Adj, fill = factor(Study))) + 
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = .5, width = .8, .width = 0, justification = -.3, point_colour = NA) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = .4, outlier.shape = NA,lwd = .1) +
    #ggdist::stat_dots(side = "left", dotsize = .5, justification = 1.1, binwidth = .1) +
    geom_jitter(width = .05, alpha = .3,size = 0.2) +
   # scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
    ggtitle("Burden Raincloud Plot") +
      labs(x = "Score") +
    theme_classic() +
      facet_wrap(~Group,scales = "free") +
    coord_flip()
  #print(p)
  
  patch <- p_child + p_adult
  print(patch)
dev.off()
```

Burden Test Cases
------





```{r}
Burden_Df_Child_Cat <- Burden_Df_Child %>%
    mutate(across(
      ends_with("_Percentile"),
      ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA,
        .x <= 33.33 ~ "Low",
        .x <= 66.66 ~ "Medium",
        TRUE ~ "High"
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_Category"
    ))  %>% 
    select(Child_PID,Study,non_missing_count,contains("_Category"))

Burden_Df_Mat_Cat <- Burden_Df_Mat %>%
    mutate(across(
      ends_with("_Percentile"),
      ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA,
        .x <= 33.33 ~ "Low",
        .x <= 66.66 ~ "Medium",
        TRUE ~ "High"
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_Category"
    ))  %>%  
    select(Mat_PID,Study,non_missing_count,contains("_Category"))

Level_Data <- Burden_Df_Child_Cat %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Child_PID,Study,non_missing_count), names_to = "variable", values_to = "level") %>%
  group_by(Child_PID,Study ,level) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Child_PID,Study), names_to = "Level", values_to = "Count") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Level != "NA") %>% 
  left_join(.,Burden_Df_Child %>% dplyr::select(Child_PID,Burden_Adj), by = "Child_PID")

Level_Data_Mat <- Burden_Df_Mat_Cat %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Mat_PID,Study,non_missing_count), names_to = "variable", values_to = "level") %>%
  group_by(Mat_PID,Study ,level) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Mat_PID,Study), names_to = "Level", values_to = "Count") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Level != "NA") %>% 
  left_join(.,Burden_Df_Mat %>% dplyr::select(Mat_PID,Burden_Adj), by = "Mat_PID")



```

```{r}
mypal <- paletteer_d("ggsci::springfield_simpsons")

person_summary <- Level_Data_All %>%
  group_by(PID, Study) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Low    = sum(Count[Level == "Low"]),
    Total_Medium = sum(Count[Level == "Medium"]),
    Total_High   = sum(Count[Level == "High"]),
    Total        = sum(Count),
    Burden_Adj   = first(Burden_Adj),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_high = Total_High / Total) %>% 
  mutate(Over_Exp = factor(ifelse(Total >=16,1,0)))


cols_01 <- setNames(c("#5050FFFF","#5DB1DDFF"), c("0","1"))

# 2) Cohort colors (one per Study) using your palette
study_levels <- sort(unique(person_summary$Study))
base_cols <- paletteer_d("ggsci::default_igv")
mypal <- setNames(base_cols[seq_along(study_levels)], study_levels)
str(person_summary$Over_Exp)

# 3) Soft alternating x-axis bands (0–100% in 10% steps), tinted by each Study color
#    We alternate alpha to create subtle "striping" down the x-axis.
bin_edges <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.10)
bands <- lapply(study_levels, function(s) {
  n_bins <- length(bin_edges) - 1
  data.frame(
    Study   = rep(s, n_bins),
    xmin    = head(bin_edges, -1),
    xmax    = tail(bin_edges, -1),
    fill_col= rep(unname(mypal[s]), n_bins),
    alpha   = rep(c(0.05, 0.10), length.out = n_bins),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

# 4) Plot
pdf("../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Burden_toExposureProp.pdf", height = 6, width = 7.5)

burden_prop <- ggplot(person_summary, aes(x = prop_high, y = Burden_Adj,color = Over_Exp)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey35") +
  # points
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  # lightweight trend per facet
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey40", alpha = 0.7) +
  # axes & scales
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    labels = c("0%", "50%", "100%"),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_01) +
  labs(
    title = "Exposure Score vs Proportion of High Exposures",
    x = "Proportion High Exposure",
    y = "Exposure Score",
    color = "Over 20 Exposures Measured"
  ) +
  #facet_wrap(~ Study) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background= element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80"),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "grey85", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(0.75, "cm"),  # increase or decrease as needed

  )

print(burden_prop)
dev.off()

# Persist for the S14 assembler (Agg_Score_Patchplot_S2.Rmd). Panel C of that
# figure is this plot; without the save it had to be rebuilt by hand each time,
# which is why S14 shipped as loose panels rather than one assembled figure.
save(burden_prop, file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/Burden_Prop_Plot.RData")
save(burden_prop,file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Burden_Prop_Plot.RData")

```

```{r}
exposure_summary <- Level_Data_All %>%
  group_by(PID, Level) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Level, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

# Step 2: Join burden back
exposure_summary <- exposure_summary %>%
  left_join(Level_Data_All %>% select(PID,Study, Burden_Adj) %>% distinct(), by = "PID")

# Step 3: Add totals and category flags
exposure_summary <- exposure_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Total = Low + Medium + High,
    Dominant_Level = case_when(
      Low == Total ~ "All Low",
      Medium == Total ~ "All Medium",
      High == Total ~ "All High",
      Low / Total >= 0.5 ~ "Mostly Low",
      Medium / Total >= 0.5 ~ "Mostly Medium",
      High / Total >= 0.5 ~ "Mostly High",
      TRUE ~ "Mixed"
    )
  )

```


```{r}
exposure_summary %>% 
  #dplyr::filter(Study == "DCHS") %>% 
  group_by(Dominant_Level) %>% 
  summarise(Mean_High = mean(High,na.rm = T),
            Mean_Med = mean(Medium,na.rm = T),
            Mean_Low = mean(Low,na.rm = T),
            Burden_mean = mean(Burden_Adj,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  View
```
